items.prompt: After outputting a rounded mean, what state should the next window update use?

options.text: The printed two-decimal mean multiplied by k.
options.why: Rounding may have discarded information; reconstructing a sum from the printout changes later windows.
A width-k window still depends on all k active prices, not just the newest one.

options.text: The exact integer sum, minus leaving plus entering price.
options.why: The output formatting is separate from the state update, preserving exact active-window arithmetic.

options.text: The previous printed mean averaged with the next price.
options.why: That is neither the equal-weight width-k recurrence nor the declared public function.
